item.title: Trigger leads restrictions rewrite mortgage outreach rules
item.description: New FCRA amendment, effective March 5, 2026, restricts trigger lead sales, allowing outreach mainly via consent or existing relationships.

item.title: US loses 92,000 jobs in February as labor market continues to cool
item.description: The unemployment rate was little changed from January, rising slightly to 4.4%, with 7.6 million people unemployed.

item.title: Ninja Selling’s Larry Kendall: Control the habits, not the headlines
item.description: Ninja Selling founder Larry Kendall urges agents to manage daily activities that drive production, including time blocking and texts.

item.title: Angel Oak’s Tom Hutchens on new growth path for non-QMs as rates ease
item.description: Tom Hutchens, president of Angel Oak Mortgage Solutions, said in an exclusive interview with HousingWire that the non-QM segment still has significant room for expansion.

item.title: The condo queen: How a Miami broker closes $1B+ a year
item.description: Miami luxury mega-broker Maile Aguila on selling $1 billion of real estate in a year and how new agents can break into high-end condo sales.

item.title: Negative jobs report keeps mortgage rates calm amid surging oil prices
item.description: BLS reported payrolls down 92,000 and unemployment at 4.4%, as oil touched $92 and the 10-year yield reversed to near 4.12%.

item.title: FinCEN’s AML rule reshaping title processes — and buyer behavior
item.description: The rule is already prompting operational changes, new workflows and questions from buyers and sellers first encountering the requirements.

item.title: Allied Title and Escrow expands into Ohio, Michigan
item.description: The move marks another step in Allied’s national growth strategy as demand increases from real estate agents, lenders and investors.

item.title: Can innovation, policy reform redeem manufactured housing’s image?
item.description: Manufactured housing is still hampered by a persistent negative stigma, but innovations in the industry could change those misconceptions.

item.title: Redwood launches Aspire securitization shelf with $391M non-QM deal
item.description: Redwood Trust closed a $391 million securitization backed by nonqualified mortgages, marking the inaugural deal from its Aspire platform that was expanded in early 2025.
